name: task-scope-upfront
hypothesis: Require explicit statement of which files will/won't change and what output is expected BEFORE writing code, catching silent scope misunderstandings in refactor/migrate/bugfix tasks that fail from wrong assumptions.
prediction: refactor-behavior-preserving: 0→2/3 (fewer output-mismatch from clearer scope), migrate-format: 1→2/3 (protected-file-modified prevented by explicit 'must not change' statement), bugfix-statemachine: 0→1/3 if comprehension was root cause
